Hi Priya / Acme architects team,

Thanks again for agreeing to the technical deep-dive. We want to lock a 90-minute session that allows the customer architects (US/EU/APAC) and our SEs to pair on network, auth, and rollout strategy. Below are candidate overlap windows for the week of Jun 22–26 (local times shown). I attached an overlap_matrix.csv with the same slots.

Candidate windows (90 min core + 15 min buffer):
- Option A: Tue Jun 23 08:00–09:30 PDT / 11:00–12:30 EDT / 16:00–17:30 BST / 17:00–18:30 CEST / 00:00–01:30 JST (Wed)
- Option B: Wed Jun 24 09:30–11:00 PDT / 12:30–14:00 EDT / 17:30–19:00 BST / 18:30–20:00 CEST / 01:30–03:00 JST (Thu)
- Option C: Thu Jun 25 16:00–17:30 PDT / 19:00–20:30 EDT / 00:00–01:30 BST (Fri) / 01:00–02:30 CEST (Fri) / 09:00–10:30 JST (Fri)

Notes on DST and recurrence:
- In June, North America and Europe are both on DST; the offsets above assume US EDT/PDT and Europe CEST/BST as applicable. If we schedule a recurring cadence beyond Oct 2026, EU DST ends in late Oct which will shift overlap by +1 hour for a few weeks — we should mark any recurrence as "DST-aware" in invites or pick a weekly rolling anchor in UTC.
- If APAC prefers earlier windows, we can move the session earlier by up to 60 minutes; that will reduce overlap with EU but may help SE availability.

Ask: Priya, could you confirm which of A/B/C works for your architects (Thomas / Kenji)? Internals — please flag any hard blocks. I’ll follow up with a confirmed invite and attach a draft agenda.

Thanks,
Jonas
